---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement to PRISM
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. I'm always frustrated
when [...]

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

What you want to happen. If this adds or changes a modality, encoder, dataset
adapter, or platform target, say which.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

Other solutions or features you considered, and why they fall short.

## Compatibility Impact

Would this change any of the following? See *Compatibility* in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/AI-ModCon/BaseMM_PRISM/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] `src.*` import paths
- [ ] the `prism` CLI surface
- [ ] Hydra config keys
- [ ] checkpoint keys
- [ ] launcher flags
- [ ] None of the above

## New Dependencies or Assets

Does this require a new dependency, dataset, pretrained model, or tokenizer?
If so, name it and its license.

## Additional Context

Anything else — references, papers, prior art, or a sketch of the interface.
